7) Any scholarships or bursaries are only applicable if the student completes the programme with UM-Wales.
8) All fees are payable in Malaysian Ringgit (RM). Any shortfall arising from foreign exchange currency transaction to Ringgit Malaysia and bank charges will be borne by the students.
9) Post-dated cheques are not accepted.
13) A Resource and Extension Fee will be applicable for each additional semester that exceeds the duration outlined in the approved program structure.
14) For Credit Transfer Exemptions (CTE), a fee of RM106 - RM212 will be charged for processing.
15) If student register in additional module beyond the standard curriculum, additional fee will be applied.

records.name: Engineering/Engineering Technology
records.remarks:
Excluding student accommodation.

GENERAL ENTRY REQUIREMENT: Obtained at least three (3) principals in General Certificate of Education Advanced Level (GCE A-Level) Examination [UK Examination System] or International Baccalaureate (IB) obtained in one sitting. For countries which do not follow the UK examination or International Baccalaureate (IB) system, intake consideration shall be based on the equivalency of qualification table by the Malaysian Qualification Agency. Have completed at least twelve (12) years of education. Secondary school/ higher secondary school. Diploma from institution of higher learning.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS: A minimum score of 500 in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) OR A minimum score/Band 5.0 in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS). Applicants without TOEFL/IELTS or those who obtained a score/band below the requirement above are required to undergo and pass the English Program conducted by UTeM prior to commencement of the undergraduate programmes EXCEPT for Indonesia and Brunei.

SPECIAL PROGRAMME REQUIREMENTS: Engineering/Engineering Technology Programme: At least C grades (50 percent minimum) in GCE A-Level/IB Examination in all of the following subjects: Mathematics, Physics and At least C grade (50 percent minimum) in one (1) other subject. ICT/Technology Management and Technopreneurship Programme: At least C grades in GCE A-Level/IB Examination in Mathematics and C grades in two (2) other subjects. A Diploma from an institution of higher learning recognised by the Government of Malaysia and approved by the Senate of the University. Engineering Programme/Engineering Technology Programme/ ICT Programme/ Technology Management and Technopreneurship: Diploma in the related field with a final CGPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00 or equivalent.

global:301.a:
EMGS processing takes on around 21 to 28 days and for some cases it may take 35 days/+.

**Here how it works:**
- When you pay your EMGS, your record gets online in 5 to 7 days and the count starts from 5%.
- Then the status will increase to 15%, 32%, 35% and lastly 70%.

entries.q: What documents are needed for a new Student Pass?
entries.a: For a new Student Pass, prepare a recent white-background photo, passport copies, the university offer letter, health declaration, academic certificates/transcripts, and an accepted English certificate for the VAL. Passport validity must be at least 18 months. Personal bond arrangements are handled through your institution. Yellow-fever vaccination, a special-pass/exit stamp, and nationality-specific documents apply only where relevant. The institution can request additional program-specific documents. Tell me your nationality and whether this is a new, renewal, or progression application to narrow the checklist.
entries.a_bn: নতুন Student Pass-এর জন্য সাদা ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ডের সাম্প্রতিক ছবি, পাসপোর্টের কপি, বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের অফার লেটার, স্বাস্থ্য ঘোষণাপত্র, শিক্ষাগত সনদ ও ট্রান্সক্রিপ্ট এবং VAL-এর জন্য গ্রহণযোগ্য ইংরেজি পরীক্ষার সনদ প্রস্তুত করুন। পাসপোর্টের মেয়াদ অন্তত ১৮ মাস হতে হবে। Personal bond বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাধ্যমে হয়। Yellow fever টিকা ও জাতীয়তাভিত্তিক অতিরিক্ত কাগজ সবার জন্য নয়। আপনার জাতীয়তা এবং আবেদন নতুন, নবায়ন নাকি progression—জানালে নির্দিষ্ট তালিকা দিতে পারব।

entries.q: Which passport pages must I submit?
entries.a: Normally submit the passport bio-data page, every page containing visa information, and the observation page (name clarifications, extensions or previous passport numbers). Blank pages are normally unnecessary. Applicants from **Libya, Iran, Iraq, Somalia, Sudan, Syria and Yemen** must submit **all passport pages**, including blank pages. Include a Special Pass or exit stamp where applicable.
entries.a_bn: সাধারণভাবে পাসপোর্টের বায়োডাটা পৃষ্ঠা, ভিসার তথ্য থাকা সব পৃষ্ঠা এবং observation পৃষ্ঠা দিতে হয়; খালি পৃষ্ঠা লাগে না। তবে **Libya, Iran, Iraq, Somalia, Sudan, Syria ও Yemen**-এর আবেদনকারীদের খালি পৃষ্ঠাসহ **সব পৃষ্ঠা** দিতে হয়। প্রযোজ্য হলে Special Pass বা exit stamp-ও দিন।

entries.q: How long must my passport be valid?
entries.a: For a **new Student Pass**, EMGS specifies passport validity of **18 months or more**. For a one-off pass covering the course, validity of the course duration plus 12 months is recommended. For **renewal**, the supplied guidance recommends at least 12 months. The **Graduate Pass** requires at least 18 months. These are different application types; do not substitute one period for another.
entries.a_bn: **নতুন Student Pass**-এর জন্য পাসপোর্টের মেয়াদ **অন্তত ১৮ মাস** হতে হবে। পুরো কোর্সের one-off pass-এর জন্য কোর্সের মেয়াদের সঙ্গে আরও ১২ মাস রাখার পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়েছে। **নবায়নের** ক্ষেত্রে অন্তত ১২ মাস মেয়াদ রাখার পরামর্শ রয়েছে; **Graduate Pass**-এ অন্তত ১৮ মাস প্রয়োজন।

entries.q: What photo does EMGS accept?
entries.a: Use a recent professional studio colour photo on a plain white background, facing forward with closed lips and a clear, unobstructed face. No selfies, digital alterations, eyeglasses, shadows or red-eye. Religious head coverings may be worn if the face remains visible. **The supplied EMGS pages conflict on print dimensions:** the document checklist says 35 × 45 mm, while the detailed photo guide says 35 mm wide × 50 mm high. Confirm the required upload format with your institution and the [official photo checker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/guidelines/online-photo-checker). Passing the checker does not guarantee manual acceptance.
entries.a_bn: সাদা ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ডে সাম্প্রতিক স্টুডিওতে তোলা রঙিন ছবি দিন। মুখ ও চোখ স্পষ্ট থাকতে হবে; সেলফি, এডিট, চশমা, ছায়া বা red-eye গ্রহণযোগ্য নয়। মুখ দৃশ্যমান থাকলে ধর্মীয় মাথার আবরণ চলতে পারে। **EMGS-এর দেওয়া দুই পাতায় মাপের অমিল আছে:** checklist-এ ৩৫×৪৫ মিমি, বিস্তারিত photo guide-এ প্রস্থ ৩৫×উচ্চতা ৫০ মিমি। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও [অফিশিয়াল photo checker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/guidelines/online-photo-checker) দিয়ে বর্তমান upload format নিশ্চিত করুন।

entries.q: Can I apply for a Student Pass without an offer letter?
entries.a: A university/college acceptance or offer letter is required for the Student Pass application. For a self-created online application, receive the offer first before submitting the application. A provisional discussion with a counselor is not an offer letter.
entries.a_bn: Student Pass-এর আবেদন করতে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় বা কলেজের offer/acceptance letter লাগে। নিজে অনলাইনে আবেদন করলে জমা দেওয়ার আগে অফার লেটার নিতে হবে। কাউন্সেলরের সঙ্গে আলোচনা অফার লেটারের বিকল্প নয়।

entries.q: Do I need a health declaration?
entries.a: A completed Health Declaration Form is required for a new Student Pass application; self-applicants upload a scanned copy. This declaration is separate from the medical screening after arrival. Use the form linked on the official EMGS required-documents page.

entries.q: Who needs a yellow fever vaccination certificate?
entries.a: Yellow-fever inoculation and the vaccination booklet/card apply to arrivals from countries considered at risk of yellow-fever transmission. The card may be required at Immigration on entry. This is conditional, not a vaccination requirement for every nationality; confirm the current risk-country/travel-history rules before travel.

entries.q: Who needs a No Objection Certificate?
entries.a: The supplied EMGS checklist requires a **No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Sudanese students only**. The institution applies for and collects it through the Sudanese Embassy in Kuala Lumpur. Do not add this requirement to every nationality.
entries.a_bn: সরবরাহকৃত EMGS checklist অনুযায়ী **শুধু Sudan-এর শিক্ষার্থীদের NOC** লাগে। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় Kuala Lumpur-এর Sudanese Embassy থেকে আবেদন ও সংগ্রহ করে। এটি সব দেশের শিক্ষার্থীর জন্য নয়।

entries.q: Who needs a Letter of Eligibility?
entries.a: The supplied EMGS checklist requires a **Letter of Eligibility (LOE) for Iranian students only**. The institution applies at the Iranian Embassy in Kuala Lumpur; the embassy sends the LOE directly to EMGS.

entries.q: What are Student Pass renewal requirements?
entries.a: For renewal, provide the passport copies and validity, academic results, and attendance record requested by the institution. EMGS recommends passport validity of at least 12 months. The academic benchmark is **CGPA at least 2.0** and **attendance at least 80%**. If either is below the benchmark, the institution must provide an explanation letter. This is not an automatic approval or rejection decision; the authorities assess the application.
entries.a_bn: Student Pass নবায়নে পাসপোর্ট, পরীক্ষার ফল ও উপস্থিতির রেকর্ড লাগে। পাসপোর্টে অন্তত ১২ মাস মেয়াদ রাখার পরামর্শ রয়েছে। মানদণ্ড হলো **CGPA অন্তত ২.০** এবং **উপস্থিতি অন্তত ৮০%**। কম হলে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়কে ব্যাখ্যাপত্র দিতে হয়। এতে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে অনুমোদন বা প্রত্যাখ্যান হয় না; কর্তৃপক্ষ সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়।

entries.q: Can low CGPA or attendance affect my Student Pass?
entries.a: For Student Pass renewal, the EMGS benchmarks are **CGPA ≥ 2.0** and **attendance ≥ 80%**. If a student falls below either, the institution must submit an explanation letter. A score or percentage alone cannot determine your renewal outcome.

entries.q: What documents are needed when changing course or progressing?
entries.a: Variation/progression applications use the new Student Pass documents plus the relevant release/clearance/completion letter. A release letter is required when changing institution; completion evidence is relevant when moving to the next level. Confirm with both institutions which application type applies before cancelling a pass or transferring.

entries.q: Are there extra documents for Sarawak?
entries.a: Sarawak applications can additionally require an authorisation letter, cover letter and pre-VAL medical report where applicable. These are Sarawak-specific requirements, not the default checklist for all Malaysian campuses. Graduate Pass applications in Sarawak also have state-specific sponsor/form conditions.

entries.q: What is the personal bond?
entries.a: The personal bond is a nationality-based deposit lodged through the institution, which signs the bond for the student. It is refundable on completion or withdrawal if there is no breach of Malaysian immigration law. It is separate from tuition and normal processing fees. The bond form can be supplied after arrival for endorsement; errors must be corrected before the Student Pass sticker endorsement.
entries.a_bn: Personal bond জাতীয়তা অনুযায়ী নির্ধারিত জামানত; বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় শিক্ষার্থীর পক্ষে বন্ড জমা দেয়। পড়াশোনা শেষ বা প্রত্যাহারের পর অভিবাসন আইন ভঙ্গ না করলে ফেরত পাওয়া যায়। এটি টিউশন বা processing fee নয়। বন্ড ফর্ম আগমনের পর endorsement-এর জন্যও দেওয়া যায়; sticker endorsement-এর আগে ভুল ঠিক করতে হবে।

entries.q: Which English certificates does EMGS accept for the VAL?
entries.a: The supplied EMGS checklist lists MUET; IELTS/IELTS Online; TOEFL iBT/Essentials; PTE Academic/Online; Cambridge B1 Preliminary, B2 First, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency and Linguaskill; OET; and ELS CIEP. Upload the accepted certificate for the VAL. Without it, processing may be delayed and a full-duration Student Pass may not be issued. Admission waivers or a conditional offer do not guarantee a visa English exemption; confirm the exact program and certificate requirements with your institution.
entries.a_bn: EMGS-এর তালিকায় MUET, IELTS/Online, TOEFL iBT/Essentials, PTE Academic/Online, Cambridge B1/B2/C1/C2 ও Linguaskill, OET এবং ELS CIEP আছে। VAL-এর আবেদনে গ্রহণযোগ্য সনদ দিন। সনদ না থাকলে processing দেরি হতে পারে বা পুরো কোর্সের মেয়াদের Student Pass নাও হতে পারে। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের IELTS waiver বা conditional offer ভিসার ইংরেজি শর্ত থেকে ছাড়ের নিশ্চয়তা নয়।

entries.q: What is the Graduate Pass?
entries.a: The Graduate Pass is a **12-month Social Visit Pass** for eligible international graduates who complete a Bachelor's degree or higher in Malaysia. It permits part-time work in approved sectors without employer sponsorship; it does not promise unrestricted full-time employment. Apply while the Student Pass is still valid, with a passport valid for at least 18 months, completion evidence, 12-month local health insurance, a Malaysian sponsor earning at least RM1,500/month, and the personal bond. Nationality restrictions apply. Tell me your nationality and current pass status to check the supplied eligibility rules.
entries.a_bn: Graduate Pass হলো মালয়েশিয়ায় Bachelor বা উচ্চতর ডিগ্রি শেষ করা যোগ্য আন্তর্জাতিক গ্র্যাজুয়েটদের **১২ মাসের Social Visit Pass**। অনুমোদিত খাতে খণ্ডকালীন কাজ করা যায়; এটি যেকোনো পূর্ণকালীন চাকরির অনুমতি নয়। আবেদনের সময় Student Pass বৈধ, পাসপোর্টে অন্তত ১৮ মাস মেয়াদ, completion letter, ১২ মাসের স্থানীয় স্বাস্থ্যবিমা, মাসে অন্তত RM1,500 আয়ের Malaysian sponsor এবং personal bond লাগে। জাতীয়তার শর্তও আছে। আপনার জাতীয়তা ও বর্তমান pass status জানান।

entries.q: Can I work full time on the Graduate Pass?
entries.a: The supplied Graduate Pass guidance permits **part-time work in approved sectors** without employer sponsorship. It does **not** grant unrestricted full-time employment. Confirm the current permitted sectors and work conditions with your institution and Immigration before accepting a job.
entries.a_bn: সরবরাহকৃত Graduate Pass নির্দেশনায় অনুমোদিত খাতে **part-time কাজের** সুযোগ আছে এবং employer sponsorship লাগে না। এটি unrestricted full-time চাকরির অনুমতি **নয়**। চাকরি নেওয়ার আগে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও Immigration-এর কাছে বর্তমান খাত ও শর্ত নিশ্চিত করুন।

entries.q: What documents do I need for a Graduate Pass?
entries.a: Prepare a passport valid at least 18 months and a valid Student Pass, completion letter, passport photo (the Graduate Pass checklist specifies 217 × 280 pixels), 12-month locally issued health-insurance certificate, and the personal bond. The Malaysian sponsor supplies a certified declaration, NRIC front/back, and three months of payslips with supporting EPF/SOCSO/tax evidence. Self-employed sponsors provide SSM registration, three months of bank statements and tax evidence. Sarawak has additional resident-sponsor/BK-form conditions. Dependent applications require their passport/pass and insurance documents as well.

entries.q: What sponsor is needed for the Graduate Pass?
entries.a: A Malaysian citizen sponsor must earn at least **RM1,500 per month** and provide a certified declaration, NRIC copies and three months of salary records with EPF/SOCSO/tax support. Payment vouchers are not accepted as payslips and a part-time job cannot be used as the sponsor's employment evidence. A self-employed sponsor provides SSM registration, three months of bank statements and tax records. Sarawak applications require a sponsor resident in Sarawak plus the specified state form.

entries.q: Can I apply for the Graduate Pass after my Student Pass expires?
entries.a: The Student Pass must be valid when applying for the Graduate Pass. Applicants already issued a Check Out Memo, or holding a Social Visit Pass while their Graduate Pass application is processed, are not eligible under the supplied guidance. Contact your institution before pass expiry; the bot cannot extend a pass or authorise an overstay.

entries.q: Is a letter of good conduct required?
entries.a: The supplied EMGS **Graduate Pass** rules specifically require a letter of good conduct from the institution or embassy for **Chinese and Indian nationals** under the extension through **31 December 2026**, assessed case by case. This is not a universal requirement for every new Student Pass applicant. Tell me your nationality and whether you mean a Student Pass or Graduate Pass; an institution can separately ask for additional documents.
entries.a_bn: সরবরাহকৃত **Graduate Pass** নীতিতে **China ও India**-এর আবেদনকারীদের জন্য প্রতিষ্ঠান বা দূতাবাসের good conduct letter-এর শর্ত আছে; এই extension **৩১ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৬** পর্যন্ত এবং আবেদন case by case বিবেচিত হয়। এটি সব দেশের নতুন Student Pass আবেদনকারীর জন্য সার্বজনীন শর্ত নয়। আপনার জাতীয়তা ও pass-এর ধরন জানান।

entries.q: Can I bring my spouse or dependents?
entries.a: Dependent eligibility depends on the main pass type, study level, nationality and Immigration approval; I cannot confirm it from 'student' alone. For a **Graduate Pass**, the supplied rules allow eligible dependents whose existing dependent passes remain valid, with passport/pass documents, health insurance for the pass period and bond arrangements. For a regular Student Pass, ask the university's international office to confirm spouse/dependent eligibility for your exact program before planning travel.
entries.a_bn: স্বামী/স্ত্রী বা dependent আনার যোগ্যতা মূল pass, শিক্ষাস্তর, জাতীয়তা ও Immigration-এর অনুমোদনের ওপর নির্ভর করে। **Graduate Pass**-এর ক্ষেত্রে যোগ্য dependent-এর বিদ্যমান pass বৈধ থাকতে হবে; পাসপোর্ট/pass, মেয়াদ অনুযায়ী স্বাস্থ্যবিমা ও bond লাগে। সাধারণ Student Pass-এর জন্য আপনার নির্দিষ্ট প্রোগ্রামে spouse/dependent-এর সুযোগ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের international office থেকে নিশ্চিত করুন।

entries.q: Do I need a Single Entry Visa?
entries.a: A Single Entry Visa (SEV) is nationality-dependent and is separate from the eVAL and Student Pass. The supplied list includes Bangladesh, India, China, Pakistan and many other countries. Check the current Malaysian embassy/consulate requirements for your nationality after eVAL approval and before travel. Tell me your nationality to check the supplied list; do not assume every nationality has the same entry rule.
entries.a_bn: Single Entry Visa (SEV) জাতীয়তার ওপর নির্ভর করে; এটি eVAL বা Student Pass-এর একই জিনিস নয়। সরবরাহকৃত তালিকায় Bangladesh, India, China, Pakistan-সহ অনেক দেশ আছে। eVAL পাওয়ার পর ভ্রমণের আগে সংশ্লিষ্ট Malaysian embassy/consulate-এর বর্তমান নিয়ম নিশ্চিত করুন। আপনার জাতীয়তা জানালে সংরক্ষিত তালিকা মিলিয়ে দিতে পারব।

entries.q: Do I pay the clinic or is screening included in my EMGS payment?
entries.a: Check your EMGS/institution invoice for a **Medical Screening Fee**. If that screening has already been paid through EMGS, confirm the arrangement with the appointed panel clinic before paying again. Additional tests, a different clinic or services outside that invoice may have separate charges. The supplied refund policy treats the medical-screening charge as a distinct fee; it does not establish that every clinic service is free.
entries.a_bn: EMGS বা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের invoice-এ **Medical Screening Fee** দেওয়া আছে কি না দেখুন। EMGS-এর মাধ্যমে ওই screening-এর টাকা দেওয়া থাকলে আবার দেওয়ার আগে নির্ধারিত panel clinic-এ নিশ্চিত করুন। অতিরিক্ত test, অন্য clinic বা invoice-এর বাইরের সেবায় আলাদা খরচ হতে পারে।

entries.q: When is medical screening required?
entries.a: New international students must complete the required medical screening within **7 working days of arrival** in Malaysia through the prescribed arrangements. Variation/progression applicants may need a new examination if their last screening was more than 90 days earlier. Confirm the appointment and instructions with your institution. A medical result requires assessment by the authorised medical team.

entries.q: Can you decide whether I will pass medical screening?
entries.a: I cannot diagnose a condition or predict a fit/unfit or appeal decision from a chat message. Follow the result and any further-testing/appeal instructions from the authorised screening clinic and your institution. If you share the status wording without sensitive medical identifiers, I can explain the administrative step.

entries.q: Can international students work part time?
entries.a: International students may work up to **20 hours per week only during semester breaks or holidays longer than 7 days**, in permitted sectors such as restaurants, petrol kiosks, mini-markets and hotels. A valid Student Pass and prior Immigration approval through the institution are required. This is not permission to work throughout teaching weeks, and income is not guaranteed; plan tuition and living costs without relying on a job. The Graduate Pass has separate eligibility rules.
entries.a_bn: আন্তর্জাতিক শিক্ষার্থীরা **শুধু semester break বা ৭ দিনের বেশি ছুটিতে সপ্তাহে সর্বোচ্চ ২০ ঘণ্টা** অনুমোদিত খাতে—যেমন restaurant, petrol kiosk, mini-market ও hotel—কাজ করতে পারেন। বৈধ Student Pass এবং বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাধ্যমে আগাম Immigration অনুমোদন লাগে। ক্লাস চলাকালে নিয়মিত কাজের অনুমতি ধরে নেবেন না; চাকরি বা আয় নিশ্চিত নয়। টিউশন ও থাকা-খাওয়ার বাজেট চাকরির ওপর নির্ভর করে করবেন না।

entries.q: Does a Student Pass application include health insurance?
entries.a: The supplied EMGS material defines an **Insurance Premium Fee** as the fee paid to EMGS to purchase insurance coverage for the student. It does not give one universal policy, premium or coverage period for every Student Pass in this snapshot. Check the current EMGS or institution invoice, insurer, policy dates and benefits before applying or paying. Graduate Pass applicants have a separate requirement for one year of locally purchased medical health insurance.
entries.a_bn: সরবরাহকৃত EMGS তথ্যে **Insurance Premium Fee** বলতে শিক্ষার্থীর insurance coverage কেনার জন্য EMGS-কে দেওয়া ফি বোঝানো হয়েছে। এই snapshot-এ সব Student Pass-এর জন্য একটিমাত্র policy, premium বা coverage period দেওয়া নেই। আবেদন বা payment-এর আগে বর্তমান EMGS/বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের invoice, insurer, policy-এর তারিখ ও সুবিধা মিলিয়ে নিন। Graduate Pass-এর জন্য এক বছরের locally purchased medical health insurance-এর আলাদা শর্ত আছে।

entries.q: What is the EMGS Student Pass process?
entries.a: Start with an offer from your institution, then submit the application, required documents and applicable fees through the institution or the permitted EMGS online route. EMGS checks documents before Immigration considers the eVAL. If your nationality requires it, obtain an SEV before travel. After arrival, complete medical screening and the institution's Student Pass endorsement/iKad steps. Additional-document requests or authority checks can change timing; the bot cannot guarantee a completion date or approval.
entries.a_bn: প্রথমে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের offer নিন। তারপর প্রতিষ্ঠান বা অনুমোদিত EMGS online পদ্ধতিতে কাগজপত্র ও প্রযোজ্য ফি জমা দিন। EMGS কাগজ যাচাই করে; Immigration eVAL বিবেচনা করে। আপনার জাতীয়তায় প্রয়োজন হলে ভ্রমণের আগে SEV নিন। মালয়েশিয়ায় পৌঁছে medical screening এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের মাধ্যমে Student Pass endorsement/iKad-এর ধাপ শেষ করুন। অতিরিক্ত কাগজ বা যাচাইয়ের কারণে সময় বদলাতে পারে; অনুমোদন বা নির্দিষ্ট তারিখ নিশ্চিত করা যায় না।

entries.q: How do I check my EMGS status?
entries.a: I cannot access your application or check live EMGS status. Use the [official EMGS application tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S). Share the displayed status wording or percentage, without your passport number, and I can explain the available guidance. A percentage alone is not proof of approval or a travel authorisation.
entries.a_bn: আমি আপনার আবেদন বা live EMGS status দেখতে পারি না। [অফিশিয়াল EMGS tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S) ব্যবহার করুন। পাসপোর্ট নম্বর না দিয়ে সেখানে দেখানো status-এর লেখা বা শতাংশ জানালে নির্দেশনা ব্যাখ্যা করতে পারব। শুধু শতাংশ অনুমোদন বা ভ্রমণের অনুমতি নয়।

entries.q: What does pending additional documents mean?
entries.a: 'Pending additional documents' means the application needs the specific information listed in the portal request. Read that request and ask your institution to submit the correct, complete documents. This wording alone does not mean a visa rejection. A percentage such as 15% cannot identify which document is missing. I cannot see your live file or promise when the percentage will change.
entries.a_bn: “Pending additional documents” মানে portal-এ চাওয়া অতিরিক্ত তথ্য বা কাগজ বাকি আছে। নির্দিষ্ট request পড়ে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাধ্যমে সঠিক কাগজ দিন। এই লেখা দেখালেই visa reject হয়েছে বলা যায় না। ১৫% দেখে কোন কাগজ বাকি তা জানা যায় না; আমি আপনার live file বা পরিবর্তনের সময় দেখতে পারি না।

entries.q: What does an EMGS percentage mean?
entries.a: Use the status wording alongside the percentage in the [official EMGS tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S). I cannot check your live application. The supplied EMGS document does not define a reliable percentage-to-stage table, so I will not infer approval, rejection or a completion date from the number. Paste the displayed wording, such as 'pending additional documents', for a more useful explanation.
entries.a_bn: [অফিশিয়াল EMGS tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S)-এ শতাংশের পাশে থাকা status-এর লেখাও দেখুন। আমি live আবেদন দেখতে পারি না। সরবরাহকৃত EMGS নথিতে সব শতাংশের নির্ভরযোগ্য stage mapping নেই, তাই সংখ্যা দেখে অনুমোদন, প্রত্যাখ্যান বা শেষ হওয়ার তারিখ বলব না। পাশে লেখা status জানালে আরও নির্দিষ্ট ব্যাখ্যা দিতে পারব।

entries.q: How do EMGS refunds work?
entries.a: Refunds depend on the fee component, who created the application, and its processing/endorsement/cancellation stage. A student can request a refund for their own self-created, paid website application; institutions request refunds for applications they created. Processing and eVAL fees are generally non-refundable after invoicing, subject to the self-created/unapproved exception. Medical, insurance, iKad, courier and unused Immigration charges have separate rules. Tell me the component, application creator, status and relevant dates; I cannot calculate a refund from the total paid alone.
entries.a_bn: EMGS refund নির্ভর করে কোন ফি, কে আবেদন করেছে এবং আবেদন/endorsement/cancellation-এর অবস্থার ওপর। নিজের তৈরি ও paid website application-এর refund শিক্ষার্থী চাইতে পারেন; প্রতিষ্ঠানের তৈরি আবেদনে প্রতিষ্ঠানকে করতে হয়। Processing/eVAL fee সাধারণত invoice হওয়ার পর ফেরতযোগ্য নয়, নির্দিষ্ট ব্যতিক্রম আছে। Medical, insurance, iKad, courier ও unused Immigration fee-এর নিয়ম আলাদা। কোন ফি, কে আবেদন করেছে, status ও তারিখ জানান।

entries.q: Can I get a refund before the institution approves my application?
entries.a: For a self-created and paid online application that the institution has not yet approved, or has rejected, the supplied policy permits a full refund request within **90 days of application creation/payment**. Once approved/invoiced, the component-specific refund rules apply. Applications created by an institution must be handled by that institution; do not assume the self-created exception applies.

entries.q: Are processing and eVAL fees refundable?
entries.a: The first-year processing fee and eVAL processing fee are generally non-refundable once invoiced, except the policy's self-created, institution-unapproved/rejected application exception. If a multi-year application is approved for a shorter duration, unused subsequent-year processing fees may be refundable; request within **90 days of the application closing/processing ending**, as applicable. Processing delay alone is not a refund entitlement.

entries.q: Can I refund the medical screening fee?
entries.a: The medical-screening component can be refundable if the eVAL is cancelled and screening has not been used. A request after eVAL expiry can incur a **RM50 administration fee** and is subject to the policy's **90-day** limit. Screening already performed is not an unused fee. The exact route/deadline depends on your cancellation and application dates.

entries.q: Can I refund the insurance fee?
entries.a: Insurance refund depends on pass/eVAL cancellation, whether cover started and whether there were claims; a pro-rata refund may apply. Requests after eVAL expiry can incur a **RM100 administration fee**, subject to the stated **90-day** limit. Provide the policy, cancellation date and claims history to the institution/insurer for the actual calculation.

entries.q: Is the iKad fee refundable?
entries.a: The iKad fee can be refundable if the Student Pass has not been endorsed. Requests after eVAL expiry can incur a **RM10 administration fee** and are subject to the **90-day** limit in the policy. It is not automatically refundable after endorsement.

entries.q: Can I refund the courier fee?
entries.a: The unused iKad courier fee can be refunded when the courier service has not been used. A **RM2 administration fee** can apply after eVAL expiry, with the policy's **90-day** request limit.

entries.q: Is a delay enough to get my processing fee back?
entries.a: Processing delay alone does not make the processing fee refundable. The application stage, unused fee components and any specific exception determine eligibility. Ask your institution to review the refund policy against the actual dates; the bot cannot promise reimbursement.

entries.q: What are the EMGS refund deadlines?
entries.a: The applicable window depends on the event: certain applications closed for non-submission/institution closure allow **6 months**; endorsement-related requests/rejections and unused charges commonly have **90-day** windows from the specified notification or processing-end event. Self-created unapproved applications use their own 90-day creation/payment rule. If EMGS asks the institution for additional refund documents, they must be supplied within **60 days**, or the request closes. Share the exact fee, closure reason and dates before choosing a deadline.

entries.q: How are EMGS refunds paid?
entries.a: Self-applicant refunds must go to the student's own bank account, not another person's account. International telegraphic transfers are paid in USD or the destination currency; incoming amounts are in MYR. Credit-card payments can be refunded by bank transfer under the policy rather than necessarily back to the same card. Institution-created applications are refunded to the institution's account. Provide the account details through the official refund process, not in chat.

entries.q: Are convenience fees and service tax refundable?
entries.a: Convenience fees and service tax are non-refundable under the supplied policy. A refund of an eligible unused component does not imply a refund of these charges.

entries.q: What does EMGS 32% mean?
entries.a: The local FAQ describes **32%** as the stage when the file is with Malaysian Immigration for eVAL consideration. This is **not final visa approval**, and I cannot check your live application or promise a completion date. Read the wording in the [official EMGS tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S); if documents or action are requested, follow that instruction through your institution. Share the displayed wording to clarify the next step.
entries.a_bn: স্থানীয় FAQ অনুযায়ী **৩২%** পর্যায়ে আবেদন eVAL বিবেচনার জন্য Malaysian Immigration-এর কাছে থাকে। এটি **চূড়ান্ত visa approval নয়**। আমি live আবেদন বা শেষ হওয়ার তারিখ দেখতে পারি না। [অফিশিয়াল EMGS tracker](https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/emgs/application/searchForm/?___SID=S)-এ লেখা নির্দেশনা দেখুন এবং কাগজ চাইলে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাধ্যমে দিন।

entries.q: How does a study gap affect admission or a Student Pass?
entries.a: A study gap needs to be assessed with your qualification, grades, intended level/program and what you did during the gap. Prepare a timeline, CV and supporting work/study records. Working during a gap can help explain it, but neither a CV nor a particular gap length guarantees admission or a visa. Tell me the target university and program so a counselor can review the institution's actual requirements.
entries.a_bn: Study gap মূল্যায়নে আগের ডিগ্রি, ফল, যে প্রোগ্রামে পড়তে চান এবং gap-এর সময় কী করেছেন—এসব দেখতে হয়। সময়ক্রম, CV ও কাজ/পড়াশোনার প্রমাণ প্রস্তুত করুন। কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা gap ব্যাখ্যা করতে পারে, কিন্তু CV বা নির্দিষ্ট gap-এর দৈর্ঘ্য দিয়ে ভর্তি বা ভিসা নিশ্চিত হয় না। লক্ষ্য বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও প্রোগ্রাম জানান।

entries.q: What scholarships or funding can I consider?
entries.a: The local information describes merit-based scholarships and partial tuition discounts at some institutions. It does not verify a currently open fully funded award, a guaranteed discount, or nationality-specific eligibility. Compare tuition after any confirmed award, living costs, visa charges and deposits. Tell me your university/program, grades, nationality and budget; a counselor can check actual award terms. You can also review the [local scholarship options](scholarship-options.html).
entries.a_bn: স্থানীয় তথ্যে কিছু প্রতিষ্ঠানের merit-based scholarship ও আংশিক tuition discount-এর উল্লেখ আছে। বর্তমানে খোলা fully funded award, নিশ্চিত ছাড় বা জাতীয়তাভিত্তিক যোগ্যতা যাচাই করা নেই। নিশ্চিত scholarship-এর পরের tuition, থাকা-খাওয়া, visa ও deposit মিলিয়ে বাজেট করুন। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়/প্রোগ্রাম, ফল, জাতীয়তা ও বাজেট দিলে কাউন্সেলর আসল শর্ত মিলিয়ে দেখতে পারবেন। [Scholarship options](scholarship-options.html)-ও দেখতে পারেন।

entries.q: How much should I budget for living costs?
entries.a: The local Malaysia FAQ gives a broad estimate of **RM1,500–RM2,500 per month** for accommodation, food, transport and personal expenses. This is an undated Malaysia-wide estimate, **not a verified Kuala Lumpur or campus-specific quote**, and tuition is separate. Rent, room sharing, transport and lifestyle can change the amount substantially. Confirm current accommodation and transport costs for your chosen campus.
entries.a_bn: স্থানীয় Malaysia FAQ-তে থাকা, খাবার, যাতায়াত ও ব্যক্তিগত খরচ মিলিয়ে আনুমানিক **মাসে RM1,500–RM2,500** বলা আছে। এটি তারিখ-যাচাইবিহীন সাধারণ Malaysia estimate—**Kuala Lumpur বা নির্দিষ্ট campus-এর নিশ্চিত quote নয়**; tuition আলাদা। বাসা ভাগাভাগি, পরিবহন ও জীবনযাত্রায় খরচ বদলায়।

entries.q: Do I need to show a bank balance?
entries.a: I do not have a verified universal bank-balance amount for every Malaysian Student Pass or university. Financial evidence can depend on the institution, sponsor, nationality and application type. Ask the institution for its exact document checklist and any required statement period or sponsor letter. Do not confuse proof of funds with opening a bank account or the personal-bond deposit.
entries.a_bn: সব Malaysian Student Pass বা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের জন্য এক নির্দিষ্ট bank balance-এর যাচাইকৃত অঙ্ক আমার কাছে নেই। প্রতিষ্ঠান, sponsor, জাতীয়তা ও আবেদনের ধরন অনুযায়ী financial evidence বদলাতে পারে। Statement-এর সময়কাল, sponsor letter ও সঠিক checklist বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে নিন। এটি bank account খোলা বা personal bond-এর একই বিষয় নয়।

entries.q: Can I study without IELTS or with a low English-test score?
entries.a: IELTS is not the only English qualification listed by EMGS, but an admission waiver depends on the exact university and program. A conditional offer or English pathway must be confirmed by the institution, including progression criteria and fees; a failed test does not establish direct-entry eligibility. EMGS requires an accepted English certificate for the VAL; missing it can delay processing or affect pass duration. Tell me the university, level/program and any English qualification you hold.
entries.a_bn: EMGS-এর তালিকায় IELTS ছাড়াও ইংরেজি পরীক্ষার সনদ আছে। তবে admission waiver নির্দিষ্ট বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও প্রোগ্রামের নিয়মের ওপর নির্ভর করে। Conditional offer বা English pathway, পরের ধাপের শর্ত ও ফি প্রতিষ্ঠান থেকে নিশ্চিত করতে হবে; test-এ ফেল করলে direct entry ধরে নেওয়া যাবে না। VAL-এর জন্য গ্রহণযোগ্য সনদ না থাকলে processing বা pass-এর মেয়াদে প্রভাব পড়তে পারে। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, প্রোগ্রাম ও আপনার ইংরেজি সনদের তথ্য জানান।

entries.q: Which university has the best ranking?
entries.a: Name the university and ranking system you want to compare. The local ranking dataset contains dated, sourced QS World and QS Asia results and Malaysia positions calculated within the QS World table. Missing editions and subject rankings need separate verification. For a study shortlist, share your intended subject, level and budget.
entries.a_bn: যে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও র‍্যাঙ্কিং সিস্টেম তুলনা করতে চান তার নাম জানান। স্থানীয় ডেটায় সূত্রসহ নির্দিষ্ট সংস্করণের QS World, QS Asia এবং QS World তালিকা থেকে গণনা করা Malaysia-তে অবস্থান আছে। অনুপস্থিত সংস্করণ ও বিষয়ভিত্তিক র‍্যাঙ্ক আলাদা করে যাচাই করতে হবে। পড়াশোনার জন্য বাছাই করতে বিষয়, শিক্ষাস্তর ও বাজেট জানান।

entries.q: What is the admission or application fee?
entries.a: There is no single admission fee for every university. Application/registration fees, EMGS charges, deposits and tuition are different items. Tell me the university and program, and whether you mean the application fee, EMGS payment or the first payment before enrolment, so the correct published charge can be checked.
entries.a_bn: সব বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের admission fee এক নয়। Application/registration fee, EMGS, deposit ও tuition আলাদা। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ও প্রোগ্রাম জানান এবং application fee, EMGS payment নাকি ভর্তির আগে প্রথম payment বোঝাচ্ছেন তা বলুন—তাহলে সঠিক খরচ মিলিয়ে দেওয়া যাবে।

entries.q: How do I check admission with my academic background?
entries.a: Thanks for sharing your academic background. Admission depends on your qualification, grades, relevant subjects, English evidence and the target program’s entry rules. Tell me what you want to study next and your grades; I can help find the recorded programs, while the institution must confirm eligibility.
entries.a_bn: আপনার শিক্ষাগত তথ্য জানানোর জন্য ধন্যবাদ। ভর্তি নির্ভর করে ডিগ্রি, ফল, সংশ্লিষ্ট বিষয়, ইংরেজির সনদ ও লক্ষ্য প্রোগ্রামের শর্তের ওপর। আগে BBA শেষ করেছেন মানেই আবার BBA পড়তে চাইছেন ধরে নিচ্ছি না। এরপর কী পড়তে চান ও ফল জানান; সংরক্ষিত প্রোগ্রাম খুঁজে দিতে পারব, যোগ্যতা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় নিশ্চিত করবে।

entries.q: Can you confirm whether my qualifications are accepted?
entries.a: Please give your academic qualification, grades, target university, study level and program. I cannot confirm acceptance from an unspecified document or profile; the institution decides against the program's entry requirements.
entries.a_bn: আপনার ডিগ্রি, ফল, লক্ষ্য বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, শিক্ষাস্তর ও প্রোগ্রাম জানান। কোন কাগজ বা যোগ্যতা তা না জেনে গ্রহণযোগ্যতা নিশ্চিত করা যায় না; নির্দিষ্ট প্রোগ্রামের শর্ত অনুযায়ী প্রতিষ্ঠান সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়।

entries.q: What is my chance of visa approval?
entries.a: The local data does not provide a reliable visa-success percentage for your nationality or study-gap profile. Admission, document completeness, academic history and immigration checks must be reviewed for the actual application. No university choice, counselor or chat answer can guarantee visa approval.
entries.a_bn: আপনার জাতীয়তা বা study-gap profile-এর জন্য নির্ভরযোগ্য visa-success শতাংশ স্থানীয় তথ্যে নেই। আসল আবেদনে ভর্তি, কাগজপত্র, শিক্ষাগত ইতিহাস ও Immigration যাচাই হয়। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় নির্বাচন, কাউন্সেলর বা chat-এর উত্তর দিয়ে visa নিশ্চিত করা যায় না।

entries.q: Can prior study or a diploma give me credit transfer?
entries.a: Credit transfer is not guaranteed. The receiving institution must map your official transcript, detailed subject syllabi, contact hours, grades and prior accreditation against the exact target program, then confirm the exempted subjects, remaining duration and fees in writing. The local catalog does not contain individual APU, UCSI or other university credit decisions. Ask the target university for a formal credit assessment before relying on a shorter course or lower fee.
entries.a_bn: Credit transfer নিশ্চিত নয়। যে প্রতিষ্ঠানে ভর্তি হবেন, তারা official transcript, প্রতিটি বিষয়ের বিস্তারিত syllabus, contact hours, ফল ও আগের প্রতিষ্ঠানের accreditation লক্ষ্য প্রোগ্রামের সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে দেখবে। কোন বিষয় ছাড় পাবে, বাকি সময় ও ফি কত হবে—লিখিত formal credit assessment নিন। স্থানীয় catalog-এ APU, UCSI বা অন্য বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের ব্যক্তিভিত্তিক credit decision নেই।

entries.q: Can I transfer from my Malaysian university to the UK?
entries.a: A UK transfer depends on the exact program, partner agreement, credits completed, grades and the receiving university's decision. I do not have a verified current articulation agreement for your specific course. Ask your university for the named UK partner, transferable credits, remaining study duration and fees before relying on a transfer pathway.

entries.q: How do I apply for a Malaysian Government Scholarship?
entries.a: The local data does not verify the current Malaysian Government/Malaysia International Scholarship application window, eligible nationalities or official application requirements. Review the [local Malaysia scholarship guide](malaysia-scholarship.html), then confirm the current official call for the exact award before applying. Have your qualifications, transcripts, English evidence and proposed program details ready for review; this is preparation guidance, not an official checklist or a promise of funding.

bac.title: BAC Education Group: start with the institution behind the course
bac.dek: Law may be the best-known route, but the BAC name covers several providers, awards and study settings.
paragraphs: BAC Education Group grew around Brickfields Asia College and now brings several education providers under one group. Law remains its most recognisable area, while the course list also reaches business, computing, media, hospitality and postgraduate study. That range is useful, but it makes the small print especially important: the BAC brand, the teaching institution and the body that awards a qualification are not always the same thing.

The group has an urban presence in Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya. Libraries, moot court facilities, collaborative spaces and student events shape the environment shown in the gallery. A city-based campus may suit a student who values public transport and access to professional firms, although the daily journey, facilities and timetable depend on the institution and location named for the selected programme.

Students considering a partner or transfer route should map the whole degree before applying. Ask where every stage is taught, whether progression depends on grades, what appears on the final certificate and whether an overseas period changes the visa or total cost. For law, recognition and professional training requirements must also be checked in the country where the graduate intends to practise.

Use the course and fee section on this page as a shortlist, then request the latest programme outline and written fee schedule for the intended intake. Compare tuition with registration charges, learning materials, accommodation and transport. A careful programme-level comparison gives a much clearer picture than relying on a group-wide reputation or a partner university name alone.

alfa.title: ALFA University College: look closely at how creative courses are taught
alfa.dek: A Subang Jaya setting where studios, briefs and portfolio work matter as much as the programme title.
paragraphs: ALFA University College is based in Subang Jaya, Selangor. Its listed courses include design and built-environment subjects alongside business, education and postgraduate options. For a student choosing a creative field, the useful question is not simply whether the subject is available. It is how often students work in studios, which tools they use and what they are expected to produce by graduation.

The campus is an urban learning environment rather than a large residential estate. Images of design work, computer facilities, exhibition areas and the library help show the spaces students may use. Prospective applicants should still ask to see the facilities connected to their own course, because an interior design studio, an early-childhood learning room and a general computer lab serve very different needs.

Portfolio-based study can bring costs that do not appear in a tuition headline. Materials, printing, model making, specialist software and a suitable computer may all affect the real budget. Ask how projects are assessed, whether group work is common and which pieces can be developed into a professional portfolio. Students entering a built-environment field should also check any programme-specific recognition needed for later professional practice.

Before choosing an ALFA programme, confirm the exact award, study mode, intake and current accreditation record. The Malaysian Qualifications Register can be used to check an individual Malaysian qualification. Pair that check with the latest written fee schedule and a realistic plan for housing and travel in Subang Jaya.

inti.title: INTI International University: choose the campus, course and award together
inti.dek: Nilai, Subang and Penang create different study experiences within the wider INTI network.
paragraphs: The INTI name covers more than one institution and campus. INTI International University is in Nilai, while the Subang and Penang locations include separately named INTI colleges. This distinction matters because similar subjects can lead to different qualifications, partners or teaching locations. A student should start with the full programme listing rather than assume every INTI course belongs to the university in Nilai.

Nilai offers a larger campus setting with residence, sports and study facilities. Subang and Penang feel more urban, which changes daily questions about commuting, nearby housing and access to the city. The images on this page show parts of the wider INTI environment, but the campus on the offer letter is the one that should guide accommodation and travel plans.

INTI lists routes across business, computing, engineering and other fields, including transfer and partner arrangements. Those options can be valuable for students seeking an international pathway, yet they need a stage-by-stage comparison. Check the awarding body, transfer conditions, overseas tuition, credit recognition and whether completing the full programme in Malaysia is possible.

For an international applicant, the written offer should settle the institution, campus, intake, duration and amount payable. Use the course cards and fee table here to identify options, then confirm the current schedule directly before paying. If a programme requires labs, placements or professional recognition, ask where those activities occur and whether they create extra travel or equipment costs.

klust.title: KLUST: an infrastructure-focused university with practical questions to ask
klust.dek: Engineering, architecture and the built environment sit at the centre of a campus outside central Kuala Lumpur.
paragraphs: Kuala Lumpur University of Science & Technology is the current name of the institution previously known as Infrastructure University Kuala Lumpur. Its course list is closely associated with engineering, architecture, quantity surveying, construction and technology, alongside business and other study routes. Students may still encounter the former IUKL name in older documents, so the current institution and award name should be checked on every application record.

The campus setting gives built-environment students a useful context for thinking about design, materials, infrastructure and sustainability. Laboratories, architecture spaces, the library and nearby accommodation appear in the page gallery. Facilities should be compared at faculty level, especially for courses that depend on surveying equipment, workshops, technical software or supervised practical work.

Professional pathways need more than a broad university description. An architecture, engineering or quantity-surveying applicant should check the precise qualification, accreditation status and any later registration steps relevant to the country where they plan to work. Ask how much of the course is project based, whether industrial training is required and how placements are arranged for international students.

KLUST is not in the centre of Kuala Lumpur, so transport and housing deserve their own budget. Compare the timetable with the location of any residence, food options and the likely commute. The fee table provides a starting point; the final decision should use a current offer letter that states the intake, duration, charges and payment schedule.

cityu.title: City University Malaysia: the teaching location is part of the decision
cityu.dek: A broad course list across several locations means applicants should match every programme to its campus.
paragraphs: City University Malaysia lists programmes in fields ranging from business and computing to design, education and health-related study. Its published campus information names Petaling Jaya, Cyberjaya and Johor Bahru, with Kota Kinabalu identified as a regional centre. The presence of a location does not establish that every course is taught there, so the programme and teaching site should always be checked together.

Petaling Jaya places students within the wider Klang Valley, while the other locations create different travel, housing and daily-cost decisions. Campus photographs provide useful context, but they cannot confirm which building or specialist room a faculty uses. Ask for the exact address, timetable pattern and facility information for the intended programme before choosing accommodation.

City University offers qualifications at several study levels. Compare modules, assessment, practical work and any internship or clinical component rather than relying on the subject title alone. A programme involving a lab, studio or placement may have different scheduling and additional costs from a lecture-based course, even when both appear under the same faculty.

For a reliable budget, read the written fee schedule beside the course duration and intake. Ask what is included, when each payment is due and whether materials, examinations or practical activities create separate charges. International applicants should also confirm the campus on the offer letter before beginning visa, travel or accommodation arrangements.

cyberjaya.title: University of Cyberjaya: planning for health sciences and professional study
cyberjaya.dek: Medicine and health-related teaching shape the campus, with recognition and placements to check course by course.
paragraphs: The University of Cyberjaya is strongly associated with medicine, pharmacy, psychology and other health sciences, while its list also includes programmes outside clinical fields. This creates two separate decisions for an applicant: whether the subject is a good academic fit and whether the exact qualification supports the professional route they want to follow.

The campus is in Cyberjaya, a planned city south of Kuala Lumpur. Laboratories, anatomy teaching spaces, the library and shared areas reflect the needs of science and healthcare students. A gallery can show the main learning environment, but applicants should ask where practical sessions, clinical placements or community work take place because these may involve locations beyond the main campus.

Recognition is programme and jurisdiction specific. A medical, pharmacy or allied-health applicant should check the Malaysian accreditation record and contact the regulator in the country where they hope to practise. Entry requirements, clinical hours and licensing steps may be stricter than the general university admission requirements shown for other courses.

The full cost may include more than tuition. Ask about equipment, uniforms, insurance, health checks, placement travel and any examination charges relevant to the course. Confirm the intake and fee schedule in writing, then plan accommodation around the actual class and placement locations rather than the university name alone.

genovasi.title: Genovasi University College: understand how design thinking enters the course
genovasi.dek: A smaller programme list built around problem solving, business, media and postgraduate study.
paragraphs: Genovasi University College presents design thinking as a central part of its learning approach. Its current course list on this site includes business, accounting, media technology, education and doctoral study. The practical question for applicants is how that approach appears inside their chosen programme: through projects, workshops, client briefs, research or assessment.

A smaller institution can offer a more focused environment, but students should still examine the resources attached to the course. Ask about class format, access to software and production tools, supervision for major projects and the type of work previous students have completed. For media or design-related study, a portfolio of actual student outcomes is often more informative than a broad claim about creativity.

Postgraduate applicants need a different comparison from foundation or degree students. Research supervision, proposal requirements, delivery mode and expected contact with supervisors should be confirmed before applying. Business and education applicants should also check whether the programme is designed for working professionals and whether any weekend or blended schedule is available to international students.

Use the listed programmes and fees as an initial guide, then request the latest course structure, intake and full payment schedule. Confirm the exact qualification in the Malaysian Qualifications Register and ask what appears on the final award. Accommodation and transport should be planned around the current teaching address stated by the institution.

segi.title: SEGi University: separate the university from the wider college network
segi.dek: Kota Damansara is the university base, while the SEGi name also appears across distinct colleges and partner routes.
paragraphs: SEGi University is based in Kota Damansara, Petaling Jaya. The wider SEGi network also includes separately named colleges, so a course carrying the SEGi brand does not automatically belong to the university. This is particularly important where a programme mentions a partner or dual award. Read the full teaching institution, campus and qualification names before treating two listings as equivalent.

The Kota Damansara campus brings teaching, library and student facilities together in an urban location. The course range includes business, computing, engineering, education and health-related study. Photos of laboratories, the library, hall and dental clinic show different parts of the environment, although access to specialist facilities depends on the faculty and programme.

For a partner qualification, ask what each awarding body contributes and what appears on the final certificate. For a professional or clinical course, check accreditation, placement arrangements and the regulator's requirements in the country where you intend to work. These questions are more useful than assuming that a partner name or university ranking applies equally to every programme.

International students should compare the current written fee schedule with accommodation and transport around Kota Damansara. Confirm where every stage is taught, whether industrial or clinical training changes the timetable, and which additional costs are compulsory. The programme card on this page is a starting point; the final offer should settle the current intake and amount payable.

kings.title: Kings University College: what a city-campus course should show you
kings.dek: Central Kuala Lumpur brings access and energy, while work-based claims need programme-level detail.
paragraphs: Kings University College offers a city-campus experience in Kuala Lumpur, with listed programmes in areas such as business, computing and hospitality. The location can make access to transport, employers and city services convenient. It also makes housing and commuting an important part of the study decision, especially for students comparing the campus with institutions that have larger residential grounds.

The college promotes a work-ready approach and practical learning. Applicants should ask how that language translates into the timetable: whether there are assessed projects, employer briefs, internships or optional work experiences. If an opportunity is described as paid or connected to employment, request the current written terms and confirm how Malaysia's student-pass rules apply to international students.

A useful course comparison includes the awarding institution, programme recognition, class location and complete structure. Hospitality students may need to understand practical training and placement expectations, while computing students should ask about software, labs and project work. Business applicants can compare the balance between lectures, case studies and applied assignments.

Before paying, request a current offer that states the intake, duration, tuition and other compulsory charges. Build a monthly budget for rent, food and transport in Kuala Lumpur, then compare it with the actual timetable. A city location can be a strong advantage when the programme and practical opportunities are clearly documented.

taylors.title: Taylor's University: look beyond the Lakeside first impression
taylors.dek: A distinctive campus and broad subject range deserve a close programme-level comparison.
paragraphs: Taylor's University is known for its Lakeside Campus in Subang Jaya. The lake, teaching buildings and shared spaces give the university a recognisable setting, but their value depends on the facilities used by the chosen faculty. Taylor's lists courses across hospitality, business, computing, design and health-related fields, each with a different pattern of practical work and assessment.

The campus can support a lively student routine, with study, teaching and social spaces in one environment. Applicants should go beyond photographs and ask how their own faculty uses laboratories, studios, kitchens or project rooms. A campus visit, virtual tour or current faculty guide can help show whether the spaces match the way the programme is actually taught.

University and subject rankings may help create a shortlist, but they do not describe every module or professional outcome. Compare the current curriculum, elective choices, internship arrangements and any overseas or partner component. For programmes tied to a regulated profession, check the specific qualification and the recognition required in the country where you plan to work.

The written offer remains the key planning document for an international student. Confirm the qualification title, duration, intake, tuition schedule and additional charges. Accommodation near the Lakeside Campus varies in price and travel time, so place a realistic housing budget beside the course costs before deciding.

unirazak.title: UNIRAZAK: a focused choice for business, government and education
unirazak.dek: Programme structure, delivery mode and career direction are the useful points of comparison at this Kuala Lumpur university.
paragraphs: Universiti Tun Abdul Razak is commonly known as UNIRAZAK. Its listed programmes concentrate on areas such as business, management, government, education and postgraduate research. That focus can help students build a clear shortlist, but similar course titles may differ in specialisation, assessment and delivery mode. Read the module list before choosing by name alone.

UNIRAZAK offers a city-based study setting in Kuala Lumpur. The surrounding location can be convenient for professional events and services, while accommodation and commuting costs need their own planning. The gallery shows discussion areas, a library, hall and shared campus spaces; applicants should ask which facilities and class format apply to the intended programme.

Students interested in public policy, leadership or corporate study should look at how theory connects with practice. Ask whether the course uses case studies, industry projects, internships or research work, and how those activities are assessed. Postgraduate applicants should confirm supervision, research expectations and the frequency of on-campus sessions before making travel or work arrangements.

International applicants should request the current intake, entry requirements and complete written fee schedule. If the course is offered in a flexible, blended or weekend format, confirm that the mode is available and suitable under the student-pass arrangement. Check the exact qualification in the Malaysian Qualifications Register and use the final offer letter for payment decisions.

amu.title: Asia Metropolitan University: compare the practical side of each course
amu.dek: A career-oriented programme list where facilities, delivery and current recognition should be checked carefully.
paragraphs: Asia Metropolitan University offers programmes across business, information technology and health-related areas. The subjects differ substantially in how they are taught, so a broad university description is only the beginning. A student should compare modules, contact hours, assessment and the facilities connected to the exact qualification.

The campus gallery shows teaching rooms, shared spaces and the wider student environment. Applicants to computing should ask about lab access, software and project work. Those considering health-related study should check where practical training takes place, how placements are organised and whether equipment, uniforms or travel add to the listed fees.

Course recognition must be checked at qualification level. Use the Malaysian Qualifications Register for the specific programme and intake, and contact any relevant professional body if the goal is a regulated career. International recognition can vary by country, so a general statement about the university should not replace that programme-level check.

Before applying, request the latest course structure and written fee schedule. Confirm the teaching location, intake, duration and study mode on the offer letter. A realistic budget should include housing, transport and compulsory course expenses as well as tuition, particularly when practical sessions or placements occur away from the main campus.

apu.title: APU: choosing a technology degree by what you will actually build
apu.dek: Computing, engineering, design and digital business meet at a Bukit Jalil campus with many closely related course titles.
paragraphs: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation is based in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur, and traces its roots to APIIT. Its programme list covers computing, cybersecurity, data, engineering, design and digital business among other areas. Closely related titles can contain very different modules, so applicants should compare the curriculum rather than choose from the specialisation name alone.

The campus has a contemporary technology-focused environment with teaching, laboratory and collaborative spaces. Ask how often students use specialist labs, what software and hardware are provided, and whether professional certification or equipment costs sit outside tuition. The strongest evidence of fit is often the work produced in modules, capstone projects and competitions.

Some APU routes involve an additional award connected with De Montfort University. Students considering that option should verify the exact award wording, eligibility and current terms for their programme. They should also distinguish an award arrangement from a physical transfer: any overseas study period, if offered, needs separate cost, credit and visa planning.

For an international applicant, compare the course structure, awarding body, intake and complete written fees together. Ask how internships are arranged and whether a placement is guaranteed, competitive or optional. The programme and fee data on this page can narrow the choices; the current offer letter should settle the final route and amount payable.

help.title: HELP University: compare the campus and pathway behind the programme
help.dek: Psychology, business and transfer options are prominent, but the exact award and teaching site still matter.
paragraphs: HELP University has a long association with psychology, business and international education pathways, while its course list extends into law, communication, education and technology. Students should begin with the exact programme structure. A local degree, a credit-transfer route and a partner programme can lead to different awards, locations and total costs even when they sit within the same subject area.

The university operates across more than one learning setting in the Klang Valley. That makes the campus on the offer letter important for accommodation and travel planning. Photos show parts of the campus environment and student spaces, but applicants should ask where their faculty teaches and whether the full programme remains at one site.

Psychology applicants should distinguish an undergraduate academic degree from the later professional training required for particular careers. Students considering transfer should map the credit requirements, progression rules, overseas tuition and visa costs before treating the pathway as a single package. For every subject, compare modules, assessment and practical experience rather than relying on the partner name.

Request the current intake, entry criteria and full fee schedule in writing. Ask what is included, when a transfer decision must be made and whether scholarships apply to every stage. The qualification's Malaysian accreditation record and the final offer letter provide the clearest basis for an application decision.

icms.title: ICMS: a compact course list with an applied focus
icms.dek: Management, sports and professional subjects should be compared through facilities, practical work and the exact award.
paragraphs: ICMS is presented on this site as the International College of Management and Sports. Its programme list is more compact than those of large universities, with options connected to management, sports and other career-oriented fields. That can make comparison easier, provided the applicant checks the current institution name and exact qualification on official application documents.

The gallery shows a smaller campus environment with classrooms, student areas and library space. Applicants should ask which specialist facilities support their course. Sports-related study may require practical venues, fitness or performance equipment, while management programmes may rely more on projects, presentations and industry exposure.

Applied learning claims need concrete details. Ask how many practical hours are built into the programme, whether internships are assessed, who arranges placements and what happens if a preferred placement is unavailable. International students should also confirm that any work-based activity complies with the conditions attached to their student pass.

Before applying, verify the award title, accreditation record, intake, duration and full fee schedule. Ask about compulsory equipment, uniforms, transport or placement costs. Use the current offer letter as the source for payment and visa planning, especially if older pages or documents use a different expansion of the ICMS name.

limkokwing.title: Limkokwing University: judge a creative course by the work it enables
limkokwing.dek: Cyberjaya provides the setting; studios, briefs, feedback and student output reveal the programme.
paragraphs: Limkokwing University of Creative Technology is based in Cyberjaya and is associated with design, media and creative technology. Its listed subjects include graphic design, animation, fashion, film and digital production. Creative labels can sound similar, so applicants should compare the modules and the type of portfolio each course is designed to develop.

The campus has a distinctive visual character and spaces intended for creative work. Ask to see the studios, software and equipment used by the intended programme, and find out when students can access them. A film student, fashion student and animator need very different production resources, even when all three study within a creative environment.

Project costs deserve early attention. Printing, materials, model making, production, specialist software and a capable computer may sit outside tuition. Ask for typical briefs and recent student work, how feedback is delivered and whether collaboration across disciplines is part of the course. If an internship or industry project is promoted, confirm whether it is required, assessed and arranged by the university.

Before applying, confirm the current qualification title, teaching location, accreditation record and complete fee schedule. International students should use the programme's written requirements rather than a general institutional claim when checking future professional or postgraduate options. A strong creative decision rests on the course, facilities and body of work you can realistically produce.

lincoln.title: Lincoln University College: check the route from study to professional practice
lincoln.dek: A broad portfolio includes healthcare courses where recognition and clinical arrangements need close attention.
paragraphs: Lincoln University College is based in Petaling Jaya and lists a wide range of qualifications across healthcare and other professional fields. A large course catalogue creates choice, but it also makes programme-level checking essential. Applicants should compare the exact award, entry requirements, study mode and current accreditation rather than apply on the strength of the university name alone.

The campus and teaching spaces provide a starting impression of student life. Clinical learning may also happen beyond the main campus, so medicine, pharmacy, nursing and allied-health applicants should ask where placements take place, how they are supervised and whether travel or equipment adds to the cost. Non-clinical students can make the same kind of check for labs, software and project facilities.

Professional recognition varies by qualification and country. A student hoping to practise after graduation should consult the relevant regulator in the intended destination as well as the university. Ask about clinical hours, examinations, internship requirements and any additional steps needed after the degree. An institutional ranking or approval does not answer those profession-specific questions.

Request the latest written entry criteria, intake and complete fee schedule before paying. Compare tuition with accommodation, transport, insurance and compulsory course items. The course cards on this page help narrow a long list, while the final offer letter and official qualification record should guide the application.

mmu.title: MMU: compare Cyberjaya and Melaka before choosing the programme
mmu.dek: Technology, engineering, creative media, business and law sit across a multi-campus university.
paragraphs: Multimedia University is closely linked with Malaysia's digital and telecommunications development. Its course list spans computing, engineering, creative multimedia, business and law, with study connected to the Cyberjaya and Melaka campuses. The campus is not a minor detail: it affects the facilities, accommodation, transport and student community surrounding a programme.

Cyberjaya is associated with a technology-oriented city environment, while Melaka offers a different scale and daily rhythm. Applicants should confirm where the full course is taught and whether any semester or activity takes place elsewhere. The gallery provides a view of campus life, libraries and student activities, but the offer letter should settle the actual teaching location.

For technical and creative programmes, compare labs, software, project work and final-year expectations. Engineering applicants should check programme-specific recognition; creative students can ask to see graduate work and production facilities. Law and business students should examine electives, internships and the relationship between academic study and professional requirements.

Use the course and fee data here to build a shortlist, then request the latest curriculum and payment schedule for the intended intake. Budget separately for housing and travel at the named campus. Rankings can add context, but course content, accreditation and the work students complete provide a better programme-level comparison.

ucsi.title: UCSI University: a broad course choice that needs faculty-level comparison
ucsi.dek: Music, health sciences, business, engineering and design create very different student experiences within one university.
paragraphs: UCSI University offers a broad programme portfolio that includes music, medicine, pharmacy, business, engineering, architecture and other fields. A university this varied cannot be understood through one general description. Applicants should compare the faculty, course structure and professional expectations attached to the exact qualification.

The university's Kuala Lumpur campus is a main point of reference, while some programmes or activities may use other locations. Check the campus on the course information and offer letter before arranging housing. The gallery shows student and learning spaces, but specialist courses require a closer look at studios, laboratories, practice rooms or clinical facilities.

Different subjects call for different evidence. Music applicants may want audition requirements, rehearsal access and performance opportunities. Healthcare students need placement and recognition details. Engineering and architecture applicants should examine project work, technical facilities and programme accreditation. Business students can compare internship support and the balance between theory and applied assignments.

Confirm the intake, duration and complete written fees before applying. Ask which items are compulsory and whether placements, equipment or professional examinations create extra costs. Rankings can help place the institution in context, but the qualification record, course design and final offer are the stronger basis for a decision.

unikl.title: UniKL: choose the specialist institute before choosing where to live
unikl.dek: A distributed technical university where each institute has its own field, facilities and location.
paragraphs: Universiti Kuala Lumpur is a technical university made up of specialist institutes rather than a single conventional campus. Its programme list reaches engineering, aviation, maritime study, computing, business and other applied fields. The institute name matters because it usually identifies the specialisation, teaching facilities and city in which the student will study.

This distributed structure makes location checking essential. A programme connected with aviation, marine engineering or medical technology may be taught far from another UniKL course with a similar level. Applicants should confirm the full institute name and address before comparing accommodation, travel and access to airports or industrial training sites.

Technical study is best compared through practical content. Ask about workshops, laboratories, simulators, industry certifications and the amount of hands-on assessment. If industrial training is part of the curriculum, find out who arranges it, where placements are commonly located and whether international students face any additional requirements.

The fee table and course cards provide an initial guide, but the final budget should follow the specific institute's written offer. Confirm the intake, duration, payment schedule and compulsory equipment. A university-wide ranking offers context; the institute, programme accreditation and technical resources reveal more about the day-to-day course.

umw.title: IUMW: understand the university identity and the award you will receive
